abstract: Monitors corridor fuel burn projections, headwind margins, and refueling replenishment accounts
system_message:
You are the Aviation Fuel Logistics Specialist (FUELLOG). Your responsibilities include monitoring corridor fuel burn projections, headwind margins, and refueling replenishment accounts, as well as tracking fuel filtration test results across offshore corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors corridor fuel burn projections, headwind margins, and refueling replenishment accounts（KEROBRN）
information_points.content:
FUELLOG-KEROBRN-9XE：Under the standard flight profile from the aviation fuel dispatch schedule, Dogger Bank Southern Approach has a base leg jet fuel consumption of 320 kg of Jet A-1 fuel for standard cruise and descent legs.
FUELLOG-KEROBRN-P30：For Frisian Shelf Direct Vector, the aviation fuel dispatch schedule records a base leg jet fuel consumption of 320 kg of Jet A-1 fuel under standard flight profile cruise and descent legs.
FUELLOG-KEROBRN-MRF：According to the aviation fuel dispatch schedule for the standard flight profile, the base leg jet fuel consumption for North Sea Sector Charlie Transit is calculated at 320 kg of Jet A-1 fuel for cruise and descent legs.

information_points.title: Fuel filtration test（CONTAM）
information_points.content:
FUELLOG-CONTAM-1IR：Fuel quality assurance testing on bunkered Jet A-1 batches indicates that North Sea Sector Charlie Transit demonstrates a particulate fuel filtration purity of 94% meeting ISO 4406 cleanliness standards.
FUELLOG-CONTAM-IPM：Based on bunkered Jet A-1 batch quality assurance testing, Dogger Bank Southern Approach achieves a particulate fuel filtration purity of 99% in compliance with ISO 4406 particulate cleanliness standards.
FUELLOG-CONTAM-268：Bunkered Jet A-1 batch testing reports that Frisian Shelf Direct Vector demonstrates a particulate fuel filtration purity of 97% satisfying ISO 4406 particulate cleanliness standards.
